description: A Java interface defining a strategy for authenticating clients based on X.509 client certificates, including a method to validate certificate paths asynchronously.

classes.name: X509Authentication
classes.description: An interface for X.509 client certificate-based authentication strategy with a method to validate certificates asynchronously.

methods.name: validateClientCertificate
methods.description: Validates a certificate path asynchronously and returns a Future containing a JSON object with authentication details or fails with an exception.
